title: Explicit pulled-back generator section
statement: For schemes X and Y [def-pc-scheme], f:Y→X, an invertible X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module] with invertible tensor pullback f*L [def-pc-module-pullback], and an étale W→X, construct a map from the generator torsor T_L(W) [def-sc-gm-torsor] to T_f*L(W×_X Y). For a trivialization s:W*O_X≅W*L, pull s back along p:W×_X Y→W. Use the structure-module comparisons, p followed by W→X equals q followed by f, and pullback composition to identify its source as q*O_Y and its target as q*f*L. The tensor/abstract pullback comparison is a local expression from the proved nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and Mathlib leftAdjointUniq. The resulting explicit composite is an isomorphism, hence a generator.

proof.text: The proved nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction have the same right adjoint. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. Form the displayed composite of pullbackObjUnitIso, pullback of s, pullbackComp, pullbackCongr, and the tensor comparison. Package its hom and IsIso proof as a lifted generator.
